name: Couch Stretch with Reachovers
instructions: Set up for the Couch Stretch with Reachovers with just your bodyweight. Get into a comfortable starting position.
Move slowly into the stretch until you feel a gentle pull — never pain.
Breathe steadily and hold or flow through the movement, staying relaxed outside the target area.
cues: Stay relaxed outside the target area
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: Couch Stretch with Reachovers is a beginner mobility exercise for the other, performed with just your bodyweight.
